info.name: AstroApp Mobile API
info.description:
Complete API collection for AstroApp Mobile Frontend.

**Base URL:** `http://98.88.19.190:8000`

**Auth:** All protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` header.

**Quick Start:**
1. Send OTP → Verify OTP → receive `accessToken` + `refreshToken`
2. The test script auto-saves tokens to collection variables
3. Use Refresh Token when accessToken expires

variable.description: Auto-set after Verify OTP / Admin Login

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: OTP-based phone authentication. No token required.

request.description:
Send OTP to a phone number.

**Body:**
- `phone` (required) — valid mobile number

In development mode the OTP is printed in server logs instead of being sent via SMS.

Verify OTP and login or auto-register the user.

**Body:**
- `phone` (required)
- `otp` (required) — 6-digit code
- `userType` (required) — `customer` | `astrologer`

Returns `accessToken` and `refreshToken`. The test script auto-saves them to collection variables.

Exchange a valid `refreshToken` for a new `accessToken`.

Call this when the API returns a 401 Unauthorized response.

Blacklist both access and refresh tokens.

**Headers:** `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`

**Body:**
- `refreshToken` (optional but recommended) — also invalidates the refresh token

item.name: 👤 Customer
item.description:

**Requires:** Auth token with `userType: customer`

request.description: Update customer profile. All fields are optional — only send what needs to be changed.

header.description: Get this from GET /csrf-token. Must be used together with the csrf cookie.

formdata.description: Image file (JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 5 MB)

request.description:
Upload a customer profile photo without authentication. Returns a photoUrl.

**CSRF is required** (no Bearer token on this route):
1. Call `GET /csrf-token` first → save the cookie and copy `csrfToken` value.
2. Send this request with the `x-csrf-token` header + the saved cookie.

**Note:** This only returns the photoUrl. To save the photo to the user profile, call `PATCH /customer/profile/photo` with a Bearer token.

formdata.description: Image file (JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 5 MB)

request.description: Replace the logged-in customer profile photo. Requires Bearer token. Field name must be "photo".

request.description:
Update astrologer's own profile. All fields are optional.

**Validations:**
- `bio` — max 1000 characters
- `experience` — non-negative integer
- `chatRate`, `callRate`, `videoRate` — non-negative numbers
- `specializations` — array of: `vedic`, `tarot`, `numerology`, `vastu`, `palmistry`, `face_reading`, `prashna`, `muhurta`, `kundali`, `lal_kitab`

**Requires:** Auth token with `userType: astrologer`

Toggle online/offline availability for a specific consultation type.

**Body:**
- `type` — `chat` | `call` | `video`
- `available` — `true` | `false`

**Requires:** Auth token with `userType: astrologer`

item.name: 📋 Astrologer Registration (KYC)
item.description:
Astrologer onboarding/KYC flow.

**Requires:** Auth token with `userType: astrologer`

**Step-by-step flow:**
1. Upload profile photo → get URL
2. Upload PAN photo → get URL
3. Upload Aadhar photo → get URL
4. Upload certificates (optional) → get URLs
5. Submit KYC with all URLs + personal/bank details
6. Poll registration status until `approved`

request.description:
Upload a single document. Returns the file URL to reference in Submit KYC.

**Content-Type:** `multipart/form-data`

**`documentType` values:**
- `profilePhoto`
- `panPhoto`
- `aadharPhoto`
- `certificate`
- `other`
List all documents previously uploaded by this astrologer.

request.description:
Submit KYC details. Use URLs returned from the Upload Document API.

**Required fields:**
- `fullName`, `degree`, `experience` (years), `secondaryContact`
- `profilePhotoUrl` — from upload API
- `panCard.number` (format: `ABCDE1234F`), `panCard.photoUrl`
- `aadharCard.number` (12 digits), `aadharCard.photoUrl`
- `address.city`, `address.state`, `address.pincode` (6 digits)
- `bankDetails.accountHolderName`, `accountNumber`, `bankName`
- `bankDetails.ifscCode` (format: `ABCD0XXXXXX`)

**Optional (new fields):**
- `displayName` — public-facing name shown to customers
- `dob` — date of birth in `DD/MM/YYYY` format
- `gender` — `male`, `female`, or `other`
- `chatRate` — per-minute chat rate (₹)
- `voiceCallRate` — per-minute voice call rate (₹)
- `videoCallRate` — per-minute video call rate (₹)
- `bio`, `certificateUrls[]`, `address.street`, `bankDetails.upiId`, `specializations[]`, `languages[]`

Check the current KYC approval status.

**Possible statuses:** `pending` | `approved` | `rejected` | `suspended`

If `rejected`, the response includes `rejectionReason`.

item.name: 📞 Consultation
item.description:
Book and manage consultations between customers and astrologers.

**Requires:** Auth token (customer or astrologer)

request.description:
Book a consultation with an astrologer. Customer only.

**Body:**
- `astrologerId` (required) — target astrologer's user ID
- `type` (required) — `chat` | `call` | `video`
- `customerNote` (optional) — initial message/question

response.name: Success

request.description:
List consultations for the logged-in user.

Automatically returns customer's or astrologer's consultations based on the token's `userType`.
Get full details of a single consultation by ID.

Astrologer accepts or rejects a pending consultation request.

**Body:**
- `accept: true` → status becomes `active` (session begins)
- `accept: false` → status becomes `cancelled`

**Requires:** Auth token with `userType: astrologer`

End an active consultation and mark it as `completed`.

Can be triggered by either the customer or astrologer.

item.name: 💬 Chat
item.description:
Chat message history. Real-time messaging is via Socket.IO — these REST APIs load message history.

**Requires:** Auth token

request.description:
Fetch paginated chat messages for a consultation.

To load older messages, increment `page`. Messages are sorted newest first.

Mark all messages in a conversation as read for the logged-in user. Resets unread badge count.

Set `{{conversation_id}}` from the consultation object.

item.name: 💰 Wallet
item.description:
Wallet balance and Razorpay recharge flow.

**Recharge flow:**
1. Create Payment Order → get `orderId`
2. Pass `orderId`, `amount`, `currency`, `keyId` to Razorpay SDK
3. On payment success, call Verify Payment with the SDK response

request.description: Get the logged-in user's current wallet balance.

Create a Razorpay order for wallet recharge.

**Body:**
- `amount` (required) — amount in INR, minimum 1

Returns `orderId`, `amount` (in paise), `currency`, `keyId` — pass these to Razorpay SDK.

Verify the Razorpay payment and credit the wallet.

Call this after the Razorpay SDK payment sheet closes successfully.

**Body (all required):**
- `orderId` — `razorpay_order_id` from SDK callback
- `paymentId` — `razorpay_payment_id` from SDK callback
- `signature` — `razorpay_signature` from SDK callback
- `amount` — same amount in INR passed to Create Order
Get paginated wallet transaction history.

Razorpay webhook receiver — called by Razorpay servers automatically.

**Do NOT call this manually in production.**

Configure URL in Razorpay Dashboard → Webhooks:
`http://98.88.19.190:8000/api/v1/wallet/webhook`

The `x-razorpay-signature` header is added by Razorpay for verification.
